summary: The added trait Scaladoc accurately matches the documented API surface: MacroAnnotation is a StaticAnnotation whose transform contract allows rewriting the annotated definition and adding definitions during compilation.

bonus_findings.issue: Pre-existing @return text says additional new definitions follow the transformed definition, but the surrounding pre-existing description and examples allow additions before or after the transformed definition, preserving order.
bonus_findings.suggestion: Change the @return description to avoid imposing order, e.g. “a non-empty list containing the transformed definition, which must reuse the original symbol, and any additional new definitions.”
